metadata.name: source
metadata.value: case-studies/ICS_ATTACKS_AND_ADVISORIES_2024_2026.md; ATT&CK v20.0 pages C0041, C0063, G1017, S9046; CISA AA23-335A, AA24-038A, AA25-343A and AA26-097A; library data/attack/campaign_profiles.jsonl and group_profiles.jsonl

metadata.name: score_meaning
metadata.value: 100 means a source cited in the case study (a government advisory, or an ATT&CK campaign, group or software page) maps the technique to a 2023 to 2026 ICS event; no severity, prevalence, or coverage is measured.

metadata.name: tactic_policy
metadata.value: Each selected technique is shown under all tactics it has in data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl. This is display expansion, not a claim that every tactic applies to the procedure.

metadata.name: attack_version
metadata.value: MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise v20.0: technique IDs and tactics normalized to data/attack/technique_profiles.jsonl by scripts/build_navigator_layers.py
